source.description: Raw field-survey data for Dryophytes suweonensis, 2014-2017.

purpose: Audit whether the independent Korean multi-site time series can test temporal gating and persistent local acoustic templates outside NAAMP.

eligibility.download: Supplementary XLSX must resolve from the DOI without credentials and receive a fixed SHA-256.
eligibility.temporal: A site identifier and survey year/date must permit repeated-site histories spanning at least 2014-2017.
eligibility.response: A focal D. suweonensis calling count or intensity field must be identifiable without reconstructing it from publication figures.
eligibility.site_memory_gate: At least 100 sites must have observations in >=3 years, with at least 15 site-year zero/absent calling records and at least 100 positive site-year records.
eligibility.rain_gate: For a rainfall replication, the raw file must contain either coordinates per site or an unambiguous site-coordinate key, plus survey date. If not, no new ERA5 rainfall analysis is authorized.

phase2_rule: No response model is fit in this audit. If a gate passes, freeze a separate phase-2 contract before inspecting the corresponding association.
boundaries: One focal species cannot replicate NAAMP community boundary geometry.
Field-survey calling counts are not identical to NAAMP CallingIndex.
Existing publication results on population trend and encroachment are not treated as blind validation.
No RC11 manuscript change is authorized.
